note: A gas's molar volume (GAME_SPEC §6 Pistons, §13.7, Stage 79; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 28): a 250 mL conical flask of 20 mL of 1 M sulfuric acid (0.02 mol in 19.2 g of water), a jar of 0.50 g of malachite (2.26 mmol, its carbonate 2.26 mmol of carbon dioxide), and a 100 mL glass gas syringe, empty, its plunger free. The malachite tipped in, the syringe put on the flask's mouth at once: the carbon dioxide pushes its plunger out, at the room's pressure, by about 55 mL at 20 C (a little of it dissolves in the acid): its volume over its moles, about 24 L/mol.
